ModMetaData.name: Letter Stack Cleaner 2 [1.4, 1.5, 1.7]
ModMetaData.author: RunningBugs
ModMetaData.description:
Supports RimWorld 1.4, 1.5 and 1.7 beta. Release Delete to clear the letter stack in map or world view.
This is a re-implementation of the mod Letter Stack Cleaner. I started the re-implementation due to the original mod does not support the action in World view.
